<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter idkrx mcp:submissions` from the site's AI app list. Edit that, not this file. -->

IdkRx is a remote MCP server. Adding it gives the assistant tools to report whether a US pharmacy has a medication in stock and, for pharmacy staff on an IdkRx rep plan, to post the pharmacy's verified availability and public notice. Every write is previewed and confirmed before it is made.

To connect it:

1. Identify which AI app you are running in.
2. Open that app's screen for adding a custom connector (below).
3. Add a connector with the URL `https://mcp.idkrx.com/mcp`. It uses OAuth, so there is no API key to paste.
4. When the app opens IdkRx's sign-in, sign in with an IdkRx account and approve access.

Where each app adds a custom connector:

- Claude: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors
- ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/plugins
- Perplexity: https://www.perplexity.ai/account/connectors
- Grok: https://grok.com/connectors
- Muse: https://www.meta.com/help/artificial-intelligence/1687253048996149/ (There is no screen to paste the URL into: ask Muse in chat to create a connector for it. US only.)
